title: Best Full Marathons in Southeast Asia
intro: From a temple-park course in Indonesia to a coastal city marathon in Vietnam, this list pulls every verified race tagged to the Full Marathon category across Southeast Asia, ranked by reliability score, with no single country filter applied.
editorial_notes: Region-spanning counterpart to best-full-marathons-thailand.json -- same category filter, no region_id, so it surfaces the full regional field rather than one country.

faqs.question: How does this list differ from the Thailand-only full marathon guide?
faqs.answer: This guide applies only a category filter (Full Marathon) with no region restriction, so it ranks verified full marathons from every covered country together. The Thailand-specific guide applies an additional region filter, narrowing the same category down to races within Thailand alone.
